name: Off-Road Vehicle
description: Any self-propelled vehicle designed or adapted for off-road use, dirt bikes included, that isn't registered under the Motor Vehicle Act; an electric dirt bike like a Sur-Ron or Talaria ridden off-road is one.

restrictions.rule: Designed or adapted for off-road use and not registered under the Motor Vehicle Act; no limit on motor power or speed
restrictions.citation: Off-Road Vehicle Act, SNB 1985, c O-1.5, s. 1

restrictions.rule: A two-wheeled dirt bike isn't an all-terrain vehicle, which needs three or more tires or four tracks
restrictions.citation: Off-Road Vehicle Act, SNB 1985, c O-1.5, s. 1

restrictions.rule: Must be registered by an owner 16 or older, with a number plate or decal
restrictions.citation: Off-Road Vehicle Act, SNB 1985, c O-1.5, s. 3

restrictions.rule: The Act requires liability insurance for snowmobiles and all-terrain vehicles, not dirt bikes
restrictions.citation: Off-Road Vehicle Act, SNB 1985, c O-1.5, s. 3

restrictions.rule: Riders must be 16 or older; one aged 14 or 15 may ride a vehicle the regulations deem suitable for that age, supervised by and in clear view of someone 19 or older
restrictions.citation: Off-Road Vehicle Act, SNB 1985, c O-1.5, s. 19.1

restrictions.rule: Every rider and passenger must wear a helmet meeting the Motor Vehicle Act's motorcycle standards
restrictions.citation: Off-Road Vehicle Act, SNB 1985, c O-1.5, s. 21

restrictions.rule: Not allowed within 7.5 metres of the travelled part of a highway, except to cross a road after stopping, to unload, in an emergency or at a permitted event, or where a municipal by-law allows
restrictions.citation: Off-Road Vehicle Act, SNB 1985, c O-1.5, ss. 16–19

restrictions.rule: Crossing an arterial or collector highway takes a rider 16 or older
restrictions.citation: Off-Road Vehicle Act, SNB 1985, c O-1.5, s. 17
